capabilities: Open and read .epub files in scroll or page mode
Read text aloud using offline system TTS voices
Highlight and scroll to the spoken sentence, with speed control
Jump between sentences, pages, or chapters during playback
Remember reading position and toggle a table of contents sidebar
extras: Uses the operating system's native offline TTS voices; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README solicits donations.
problem: Obsidian cannot open EPUB e-book files or read them aloud, so users must leave the app to read or listen to their books.
summary: EPUB reader that opens .epub books inside Obsidian with system text-to-speech, sentence highlighting, scroll/page modes and a table of contents.
